children: Installed Building Products entered into an amendment to its term loan agreement to add $250 million in incremental term loans, funded on October 27, 2026. The new loans carry the same terms as the existing Tranche B-3 loans, bringing total term loans outstanding to approximately $737.5 million. Borrowing rates are adjusted SOFR plus 1.75% or an alternative base rate plus 0.75%, at the company's option, and the loans mature on March 28, 2031.
